pages.text: Tools are also needed in this world. It turned out to be impossible to get the resources I needed for tools in the usual way, the floor was incredibly hard, and I couldnt find any trees in this world. But the solution was always at hand, in this world there are ready-made boards, namely, in furniture, the same with the rest of the resources.
But even so, I had to replace a lot of materials with their alternatives. In order not to forget my ingenious DIY projects and share them with you, Im going to write them down now.
